title: Closing remarks and thanks
summary: She has nothing more to add, says she may join the Jazz Club, and thanks the interviewer.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing the interview: thanks, goodbyes and tape running out

blocks.x: Do you think you have anything else to add on the line of social justice to the world

in jazz? I know I really don't, but I'm a joy being with you, and I wish that I had belonged to the Jazz Club all these years, because I would have been, had more at my fingertips to answer and to add to your little interview. And in fact, I think I will join, try to join up with the club now that I have more free time. Thank you very much.
